ENGINEERED FOR REASONING

Built to go beyond the answer.

A difficult question demands more than a convincing response.

Mindscape Epitome brings together neural interpretation, structured computation and verification to solve supported problems across mathematics, physics and programming.

Developed within Mindscape’s Applied Reasoning & Verified Intelligence research vertical, Epitome transforms supported questions into meaningful computational tasks, checks their outcomes and presents the results through an intuitive conversational experience.

Epitome presents the detachable Candidate C hybrid system under its new name. The native Mindscape architecture remains a separate experimental research track.

EPITOME IN ACTION

See intelligence in motion.

A mathematical expression becomes a worked solution.
Physical quantities become a calculated result.
Code becomes an understandable sequence of operations.

Watch Epitome approach supported problems across three disciplines.

THE EVIDENCE

Performance, measured.

36/36 on a targeted STEM challenge. 12/12 on a separate release holdout. An improvement of 61.11 percentage points over the previous Mindscape B system on the matched hard benchmark.

The gains primarily reflect expanded computational methods, improved routing and verification.

The evaluation covers supported, often structured questions. Broader generalization remains an active area of research.

Explore the results ↗Scope and notes ↓

These results measure bounded, often schema-driven computation. They do not demonstrate complete Class 12 syllabus mastery or unrestricted natural-language reasoning. Gains primarily reflect deterministic solvers, routing and verification, with no additional pretrained-model training.

01 / MATHEMATICS

More than the final equation.

From composite derivatives to definite integrals, Epitome applies structured mathematical computation to supported problems.

Its capabilities include symbolic differentiation, integration, matrix operations, linear systems, conditional probability and selected differential equations.

Epitome preserves expressions, identifies applicable operations and presents checked results with supporting steps.

Expressions, transformed into understanding.

For the expression above, the system differentiates each factor, identifies the relevant rules and preserves the resulting derivative alongside its original worked solution. A follow-up can then explain why those rules apply.

Inspect the recorded example ↗

02 / PHYSICS

Every quantity matters.

Physics is a language of relationships—between forces, fields, energy, motion and time.

Epitome approaches supported physical calculations through structured quantities, established equations and dimensional checks.

From electric fields and circuit networks to electromagnetic induction, optics and photoelectric calculations, the system works with numerical values, physical units and defined sign conventions.

Scientific computation, grounded in measurable quantities.

Given a changing flux across a coil, Epitome calculates induced electromotive force using the supplied values and specified flux direction. Complex circuits and new physics tasks may require explicit structured inputs.

03 / PROGRAMMING

Understand what code actually does.

Code is not just syntax. It is behavior.

Epitome evaluates supported Python programs through bounded execution analysis, tracking control flow, variable changes and outputs.

Its capabilities extend to functions, loops, recursion, exceptions, data structures, inline CSV analysis and restricted SQL operations.

Instead of only describing a program, Epitome can present its supported execution outcome.

From instructions to execution. From execution to clarity.

BEYOND THE FIRST ANSWER

The conversation doesn’t end at the solution.

Solve a problem.
Then ask why.

Epitome can revisit a previously verified result, explain a formula, simplify a concept or clarify an individual step—all without requiring the original question to be repeated while its context remains available.

Mindscape EpitomeGrounded follow-up
Differentiate esin(2x) cos(x3).
Epitome

Use the product rule, then the chain rule for each factor.

e^sin(2x) [2 cos(2x) cos(x³) − 3x² sin(x³)]Original checked derivative preserved.
Explain that in simpler terms.
Epitome

We have two expressions multiplied together. The product rule tells us to differentiate one part at a time, keeping the other unchanged, then add the results. The chain rule handles the expressions nested inside each function.

Illustrative explanation from the supplied copy; explanatory prose is not independently verified.

Grounded in the previously checked result. Designed to preserve mathematical correctness while making the explanation more approachable.

Grounded explanations are in feature commit eaf0c46, beyond the merged main snapshot reviewed on October 15. Context expires after 30 minutes, server restart or cache eviction. Follow-ups preserve a verified answer; they do not independently verify the explanatory prose.

INSIDE EPITOME

Intelligence takes an architecture.

Epitome combines a locally running pretrained neural backbone with Mindscape-engineered problem routing, mathematical and scientific computation, bounded program analysis, verification and conversational context.

Each component serves a defined purpose.

Interpret. Structure. Compute. Verify. Explain.

The result is an applied reasoning system built around more than text generation.

  1. 01

    Interpret

    Local pretrained neural advice.

  2. 02

    Structure

    Structured problem and routing.

  3. 03

    Compute

    Bounded mathematical and scientific tools.

  4. 04

    Verify

    Checks, units and method provenance.

  5. 05

    Explain

    Grounded follow-up context.

The local backbone is Qwen3-0.6B. Candidate C’s expanded performance comes primarily from Mindscape-developed computational pathways, routing and verification. No new pretrained-model fitting is claimed.

The integration is detachable: native source, checkpoints, training and research history remain separate. Some symbolic checks share the computation engine and are not independent proofs.

Explore the applied architecture ↗

A space to ask.
A process to inspect.

A responsive conversational workspace brings together mathematical working, code, structured tables and answer provenance. Browser-local history, projects and a Library of saved answers keep useful work close at hand.

After initial setup and model download, the application operates locally without a paid inference API. Conversations and projects are stored in the browser. There is no cloud-account synchronization.

Mindscape

Researching intelligence.
Building what comes next.

Mindscape is an artificial intelligence research initiative exploring structured cognition, grounded reasoning, neural intelligence and verifiable computational systems.

Our research spans cognitive architectures, neural generalization and advanced applied reasoning. Epitome is one of our most developed engineering systems; its hybrid capabilities are reported separately from the native research.

R6 native-model experiments exposed mathematics and coding collapse. R6.1 diagnostics identified an encoder information-flow bottleneck and a masked-pooling correction. Whether that correction improves learned generalization requires a separate experiment.

The research record includes successful engineering and negative findings. Understanding model failure remains part of developing better architectures.

Measurement notes

  1. Hard benchmark: 36 supported STEM questions, 12 per subject. Release holdout: 12 separate questions, four per subject. Both sets target bounded Class 12-style families; complex inputs often use explicit JSON schemas.
  2. Candidate C: 36/36 hard answers and 35/36 consistent worked responses before a Bayes equality formatting fix. The corrected system achieved 12/12 release answers and consistent worked responses. Reused hard36 results are regression evidence.
  3. Candidate B’s historical 31/36 score belongs to a different campaign. The matched comparison here uses 14/36. Gains are attributed to tool and routing improvements, with zero pretrained optimizer updates.
  4. Hard-set warm p95 was 8.80 s for C versus 5.85 s for B. C is slower in this campaign. Follow-up millisecond timings measure a separate deterministic path and exclude the 150 ms pacing used in the reported HTTP checks.
  5. Some verification routines share the computation engine. Implementing-agent review used separate references; independent human or blinded-team validation is not claimed.
  6. Python and SQL execution are bounded. General code execution, host files, network access, unrestricted natural-language circuit analysis and full-syllabus mastery are outside the demonstrated scope.
